description: Version updates (ADR 0017). Security alerts come from Dependabot. Images and Actions stay pinned to digests and commit hashes; Renovate updates the pin and the version comment together. The custom managers below cover the pins Renovate cannot see on its own: the Rust toolchain, Trivy, the image the isolation script uses, and the two Go modules the Caddy build names.

packageRules.description: Group Tauri's crates and its npm CLI, which must move together
The Rust toolchain moves in a pull request of its own (ci.yml says why): a new release's lints can turn clippy red, and that is fixed there
CLIProxyAPI is a third party's image and the admin depends on its management API: a new release is checked by hand, with scripts/check-cpa-image.sh, before the pin moves
prBodyNotes: Run `scripts/check-cpa-image.sh` (it needs Docker): the admin depends on this image's management API (ADR 0014, ADR 0042). CI runs it too, in the `cpa-image` job.

customManagers.description: The Rust toolchain pinned in the workflows (RUST_VERSION in ci.yml, the toolchain of build.yml)
Trivy, installed by setup-trivy at a version (ci.yml, the images job)
The image the isolation script runs its helper snippets in (the same pin as the mock LLM in compose.yaml)
The Cloudflare DNS plugin and the golang.org/x/net floor that the Caddy build names (Dockerfile, the xcaddy line)
